scripts.build: npm run build -w @crewcue/contracts && npm run build -w @crewcue/map-core && rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:memory: PERSISTENCE_MODE=memory sh -c 'npm run build -w @crewcue/contracts && npm run build -w @crewcue/map-core && npm run build && node --test $(find dist/services/api/src -name "*.test.js" | sort)'
scripts.test:pg: PERSISTENCE_MODE=postgres sh -c 'npm run build -w @crewcue/contracts && npm run build -w @crewcue/map-core && npm run build && node --test $(find dist/services/api/src -name "*.test.js" | sort)'
